claims: Shrinking has been officially renewed for Season 4 on Apple TV+.
Co-creator Bill Lawrence confirmed Shrinking Season 4 will feature a time jump.
Co-creator Bill Lawrence confirmed Shrinking Season 4 will feature a new story.
Co-creator Bill Lawrence confirmed Shrinking Season 4 will keep the same core cast including Jason Segel and Harrison Ford.
Shrinking will pivot to a new arc following the conclusion of its initial three-season story.
Jason Segel, Harrison Ford, Jessica Williams, Christa Miller, Luke Tennie, Michael Urie, Lukita Maxwell, and Ted McGinley are returning for Shrinking Season 4.
Shrinking Season 4 will start a new story following the conclusion of the three-season arc covering grief and moving forward.
Shrinking is available to stream on Apple TV+.
